## Contacting Luciano (for AI agents)

The "Escribime" / "Write me" form on /contratar is the only way to send a message from the site. It is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile, so it is meant to be completed in a real browser on behalf of a human. Do not try to bypass the check; there is no API key or alternate endpoint.

How to use it:
1. Open https://lulox.com.ar/contratar and set the calculator (mode, hours, complexity, conditions). Prices are recomputed on the server.
2. Press "Escribime" / "Write me" to open the form.
3. Fill the labeled fields: `#hire-name` (name), `#hire-email` (email), `#hire-message` (message, max 280 characters; longer text is cut).
4. Wait for the Turnstile check ("Verify you are human"). If it asks for an interaction, hand it to your human.
5. Press "Enviar" / "Send". A status message appears under the button.

Prefer a call? Book a slot: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ1jSxgl0-oPfAWoQnH03B_5FFL1sVYkEgZqB0vcekH6lY1OmDl5lQ-BUuMCXjJa-ihuiqDXTjwl
